description: This file defines classes and methods for configuring and validating persistent stream storage in Orleans, including a validator class and a configurator class for silo persistent streams.

classes.name: PersistentStreamStorageConfigurationValidator
classes.description: Validates the configuration of stream pub/sub options and ensures necessary grain storage is configured for certain pub/sub types.

classes.name: SiloPersistentStreamConfigurator
classes.description: Configures persistent streams for a silo, including setting up dependencies and validators.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Performs validation of the stream pub/sub options and grain storage configuration.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates an instance of PersistentStreamStorageConfigurationValidator with specified services and name.

methods.name: SiloPersistentStreamConfigurator
methods.description: Constructor that sets up the silo persistent stream configuration with dependencies and components.
